# EggMapper

> Fast .NET object mapper with AutoMapper's API (CreateMap, ForMember, Profile, IMapper). Maps compile to expression trees on first use. MIT OR Apache-2.0. `dotnet add package EggMapper` (DI included).

## Quick start

```csharp compile
var config = new MapperConfiguration(cfg =>
{
    cfg.CreateMap<Order, OrderDto>()
       .ForMember(d => d.CustomerName, o => o.MapFrom(s => s.Customer.Name));
    cfg.CreateMap<OrderItem, OrderItemDto>();
});
IMapper mapper = config.CreateMapper();
OrderDto dto = mapper.Map<Order, OrderDto>(order);
```

DI: `services.AddEggMapper(typeof(OrderProfile).Assembly)` registers `MapperConfiguration` (singleton), `IMapper` and `IMapper<TSource, TDestination>` (transient).

## API card

| Call | Use |
|---|---|
| `mapper.Map<S, D>(src)` | Preferred: typed, cached, fastest |
| `mapper.Map<D>(obj)` | Runtime source type (AutoMapper style) |
| `mapper.Map(src, existing)` | Map into an existing object |
| `mapper.MapList<S, D>(items)` | List mapping, one compiled loop |
| `mapper.Patch(src, existing)` | Copy same-name members whose source value is not null (needs `CreateMap`) |
| `IMapper<S, D>.Map(src)` | Inject on hot paths (no generic virtual call) |
| `query.ProjectTo<S, D>(config)` | IQueryable/EF projection; BOTH type args |
| `config.CompileMappings()` | Compile all maps now |
| `config.AssertConfigurationIsValid()` | Fail on unmapped destination members |

## Configuration

```csharp compile
public class OrderProfile : Profile
{
    public OrderProfile()
    {
        CreateMap<Order, OrderDto>()
            .ForMember(d => d.Total, o => o.MapFrom(s => s.Items.Sum(i => i.Price)))
            .ForMember(d => d.Internal, o => o.Ignore())
            .ForMember(d => d.Note, o => o.NullSubstitute("n/a"))
            .ForMember(d => d.CustomerName, o => o.Condition(s => s.Customer != null))
            .Validate(d => d.Total, total => total >= 0, "Total must not be negative");
        CreateMap<OrderItem, OrderItemDto>().ReverseMap();
    }
}
```

Also: `ForPath` (top-level members only), `IncludeBase<SB, DB>()`, `MaxDepth(n)`, `ConvertUsing(s => ...)`, `ConstructUsing`, `BeforeMap`/`AfterMap`, `AddTypeConverter<S, D>(...)`, `cfg.AddMaps(assembly)`, `cfg.ShouldMapProperty`. Conventions: same names (case-insensitive), flattening (`Customer.Name` -> `CustomerName`), records/constructors, collections and nested maps, `Map<T, T>` without `CreateMap` (shallow copy; classes with a parameterless constructor), enums by name (`cfg.EnumMapping`).

## Validation test (add once)

```csharp compile
var config = new MapperConfiguration(cfg => cfg.AddMaps(typeof(OrderProfile).Assembly));
config.CompileMappings();
config.AssertConfigurationIsValid();
```

## From AutoMapper

Change the package, `using AutoMapper` -> `using EggMapper`, `AddAutoMapper(typeof(X))` -> `AddEggMapper(typeof(X).Assembly)`. Differences:

| AutoMapper | EggMapper |
|---|---|
| `ProjectTo<D>(cfg)` | `ProjectTo<S, D>(cfg)` |
| `mapper.ConfigurationProvider` | keep the `MapperConfiguration` instance |
| `ForCtorParam`, `ForSourceMember`, `IncludeMembers`, `Include<,>`/`As<>` (polymorphic) | not supported; use `ForMember`/`ConstructUsing`, map derived types explicitly |
| `IValueResolver<S, D, M>` | `IMemberValueResolver<object, object, TSourceMember, M>` via `MapFrom<TResolver, TSourceMember>(s => ...)`; needs the DI mapper |
| `ForPath(d => d.A.B, ...)` | not supported; give the nested object its own `CreateMap` |
| `ReverseMap()` inverting `MapFrom`/unflattening | `ReverseMap()` maps by convention only; configure the reverse with its own `CreateMap` |

`IncludeAllDerived()` shares base configuration with derived maps; it does not pick a derived map at run time. `ProjectTo` ignores child collections, resolvers, `Condition`, `NullSubstitute` and nested `ConvertUsing`.

## Errors -> fix

| Message | Fix |
|---|---|
| `No mapping configured for S -> D` | `cfg.CreateMap<S, D>()` (or `.ReverseMap()` on `CreateMap<D, S>()`) |
| `Unmapped destination member 'D.X'` | `.ForMember(d => d.X, o => o.MapFrom(s => ...))` or `o.Ignore()` |
| `MappingValidationException` | a `Validate` rule failed; message lists each rule |
| `Circular IncludeBase()` | remove the cycle between `IncludeBase` calls |
